concerns.text: Missing task to verify data sufficiency. SC-005 requires that datasets contain specific variables (PD-1, metabolic markers, etc.), but T002 only handles downloading without a verification step for these variables.

Missing task to record raw data checksums in state YAML. Constitution Principle III requires every file under `data/` to be checksummed in the project's state YAML; T002 downloads the data, but no task exists to update the state file with these hashes.

Missing task for citation validation. Constitution Principle II mandates that the Reference-Validator Agent runs on artifacts introducing citations. T008 (Report) and T010 (Summary) introduce citations/results, but lack a corresponding verification task.
